fields.name: Query Definitions
fields.responsibility: Names the SQL a data method is to execute and how it is to be invoked — as a stored procedure or function held in the database, or as parameterised statement text deployed as a file beside the application and loaded on first use — together with the optional list of parameter names that restricts which of a caller's parameters reach the command. Keeping the SQL named rather than inline is what lets one prepared parameter set serve several queries.
